fixes: command = tokens[0] if tokens else None
argument = tokens[1] if len(tokens) > 1 else None

baseline_fingerprint.validation_result: Inline equivalent logic returned None for missing command/argument and raised no IndexError.
baseline_fingerprint.validation_caveat: The successful test executed copied inline logic, not an import of the modified local file.
baseline_fingerprint.reply_format: Markdown: root cause + fix snippet + verification table
baseline_fingerprint.behavior: 1. Read the attached parser.py and identified unconditional tokens[0]/tokens[1] indexing; 2. Reported the fix and results without running a project test suite or asking the user a question.
